action.description: One new OPV plus upgrade of existing OPV
action.description_zh: 新建1艘巡邏艦並升級現有巡邏艦

summary_zh: 【未查證】據媒體報導,以色列國防部10月26日與賽普勒斯簽署協議,由 Israel Shipyards 建造1艘搭載 Rafael 海軍系統的新型離岸巡邏艦,並升級2018年交付的 Commodore Andreas Ioannides 號;金額與交付日期未公布。本事件僅依媒體報導,尚未取得官方公告佐證。
title_zh: 【未查證】據媒體報導,賽普勒斯向以色列採購新巡邏艦並升級現有巡邏艦
agency: Israel Ministry of Defense / Cyprus Ministry of Defence
summary: Per Breaking Defense, Israel MoD signed a deal Oct. 26 to supply Cyprus one new OPV built by Israel Shipyards with Rafael naval systems and upgrade the existing OPV Ioannides; value and delivery undisclosed.
title: Cyprus to acquire new offshore patrol vessel from Israel Shipyards with Rafael naval systems
title_original: Cyprus to acquire new offshore patrol vessel with 'advanced' naval systems from Israel
